name: Epicureans
overview: The Epicureans, encountered by Paul in Acts 17, were philosophers skeptical of the resurrection and the gospel message he preached. Their worldview, reflected in Solomon's lament in Ecclesiastes about seeking pleasure yet finding vanity, contrasts sharply with the message of repentance and holiness exemplified by John the Baptist, who was rejected by some for his austere lifestyle. The disputes between Paul and the Epicureans highlight the tension between a life focused on earthly pleasure and the call to faith in Christ and eternal hope.
